title: Where we deliver
text: Nairobi and surrounding areas. Tell us your location on WhatsApp and we'll confirm you're within our delivery zone.

title: Delivery fee
text: A small delivery fee applies depending on your area — we'll confirm the exact amount with you on WhatsApp before you pay.

title: Timeline
text: Most orders are delivered within 24–48 hours of confirming your size and payment.

title: Prefer to collect?
text: Let us know on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a convenient pickup point and time.
